overall_summary: Analysis of the historical data reveals a massive outlier and clear engagement cluster around mature relational topics, particularly husband-wife dynamics and everyday relationship realizations, vastly outperforming generic poetry, self-motivation, or niche family tropes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,677 views) performed exceptionally well compared to the channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on complex, mature, and relatable marital or long-term partnership pain points.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable psychological question about love or regret ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' - 390 views) drive steady viewership.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, thought-provoking questions that make the viewer pause and reflect on their own behavior.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 20 views, showing low interest in overly dramatic or poetic abstractions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic rants; ground every video in a specific, observable everyday moment.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') struggled significantly, pulling as low as 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from extended family tropes and concentrate tightly on core romantic relationships and internal overthinking.
